title: 第一卷 第3章 以凡骨撑天地以凡躯承万劫第一卷 第4章 都等着迟早有一天去找你们讨债
content_zh:
顾尘意识狂震！
梦到这里，竟是跟以前不一样了！
因为这是他第一次听到女子的声音，如此真实，如此清晰！
九源？
超脱？
真灵印记？
这些都是什么？
正琢磨这句话的意思，一道远比先前更加强烈的失去感突然袭上了心头，几乎要彻底冲散他的意识！
‘怎么回事？！’
顾尘强忍着这种比死还难受的感觉，根本不明白，这个梦他以前做过了太多次，如此难受还是第一次！
‘难道……’
‘又要死一次了？’
刚想到这里。
那‘借’完了东西的神秘女子已然走到了他面前，伸出一根玉指，仿佛凝聚了诸天法则，点落而下！
“此物暂借于汝。”
“固汝残躯，定汝散魂，血肉重生，灵识复明。”
伴随着女子清冷的声音。
一点灵光悄然落下，映入了顾尘的意识之中，那道几乎让他意识彻底散去的巨大失去感，也消失无踪！
‘这是……’
曾经无数次梦醒之后，顾尘都会寻找一番，想看看梦中女子给他的东西到底是什么，只是从来都是一无所获。

而如今——
他第一次，真正见到了这东西是什么！
一枚骨片！
一枚巴掌大小，散发着湛蓝光芒的雪白骨片！
更让他震撼的！
这骨片给他的感觉，竟是比那女子的气息还要幽深玄邃了太多太多！
轰的一声！
也在此时！
他意识中忽而响起一道惊雷之音，不等梦境结束，那神秘的骨片竟是瞬间炸裂，化作了无尽的神秘符文，密密麻麻，光晕蒙蒙，玄奇高渺，宛如诸天亿万星斗高悬！
极致的霸道！
极致的桀骜！
极致的无敌！
这！
便是顾尘见到这些符文的第一感觉！
不等他细看！
星空一暗，漫天符文已然散入莫名之处，沉寂蛰伏了下来，唯有极少数的一部分，以一个极为玄妙，超出他认知的轨迹不断流转了起来！
符文流转下，更是带着一丝说不清道不明，妙不可言的特殊韵动！
恍惚中。
content_en:
Gu Chen's consciousness was shaken wildly!
When I dreamed here, it was actually different from before!
Because this was the first time he heard a woman's voice, so real, so clear!
Jiuyuan?
Detached?
True spirit mark?
What are these?
Just as he was pondering the meaning of this sentence, a far stronger sense of loss than before suddenly hit his heart, almost destroying his consciousness completely!
‘What’s going on? ! ’
Gu Chen endured this feeling that was worse than death. He didn't understand at all that he had had this dream so many times before. This was the first time that he felt so uncomfortable!
'Could it be...'
‘Are you going to die again? ’
Just thought of this.
The mysterious woman who had finished 'borrowing' things had already walked up to him, stretched out a jade finger, and pointed it down as if it condensed the laws of the heavens!
"This thing is temporarily loaned to you."
"Consolidate your broken body, stabilize your scattered soul, regenerate your flesh and blood, and restore your spiritual consciousness."
Accompanied by the woman's cold voice.
A bit of spiritual light fell quietly and reflected in Gu Chen's consciousness. The huge feeling of loss that almost completely dissipated his consciousness also disappeared without a trace!
'This is...'
After waking up from dreams countless times, Gu Chen would search to see what the woman in the dream gave him, but he never found anything.
And now——
For the first time, he really saw what this thing was!
A bone fragment!
A snow-white bone fragment the size of a palm, emitting a blue light!
What shocked him even more!
The feeling this bone fragment gave him was much, much more profound and mysterious than that woman's aura!
Boom!
Also at this time!
A sound of thunder suddenly sounded in his consciousness, and before the dream ended, the mysterious bone fragments exploded instantly and turned into endless mysterious runes, densely packed, haloed, mysterious and mysterious, like billions of stars hanging in the sky!
Extremely domineering!
Extremely unruly!
The ultimate invincibility!
this!
This was Gu Chen's first impression when he saw these runes!
Don't wait for him to take a closer look!
As soon as the starry sky darkened, the runes scattered all over the sky into inexplicable places, and they fell into silence. Only a few parts continued to circulate in an extremely mysterious trajectory that was beyond his knowledge!
As the runes circulate, there is a special rhythm that is indescribable and wonderful!
In a trance.
